description: This file contains F# unit tests for various F# data types and discriminated unions involved in serialization with Orleans. It tests the serialization and deserialization robustness of different F# constructs such as discriminated unions, recursive types, options, structs, and mutual recursion, ensuring compatibility and correctness within Orleans' distributed environment.
